title: The Enable SVG, WebP, and ICO Upload WordPress plugin before 1.1.6 does not sanitize uploaded SVG files whose content…
description: The Enable SVG, WebP, and ICO Upload WordPress plugin versions before 1.1.6 improperly handle uploaded SVG files that are not detected as SVG content. These files are stored and served as SVG images without proper sanitization, which could allow users with author-level permissions or higher to execute stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
